function.name: find_movie_showing
function.description: Find local movie theatres and their schedule for a specific movie Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Diego, CA

message.reasoning: The user wants to find two movie theaters near San Diego that have showtimes: 5pm for "Tenet" (天能) and 7:30pm for "007生死交戰" (which is "No Time To Die"). They want to find two theaters that provide those showtimes. We need to use the function find_movie_showing. The function signature: find_movie_showing takes location: string, movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], time: string[]. So we need to call the function twice? Actually we need to find two theaters that have those showtimes. We can call the function with location "San Diego, CA", movie "Tenet", time ["17:00"] and then again with movie "No Time To Die", time ["19:30"]. But the function returns any. We need to call it twice? The user wants two theaters that provide both showtimes? Or two separate theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, another for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. The phrasing: "尋找兩家電影院，位於聖地牙哥附近，提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次。" Means "Find two movie theaters near San Diego that offer 5pm showing of Tenet and 7:30pm showing of No Time To Die." It could mean find two theaters that each have those showtimes? Or find two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. Likely the latter: find two theaters that have those showtimes. So we need to find two theaters that each have those showtimes? The phrase "兩家電影院" means two theaters. "提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次" means "provide 5pm Tenet and 7:30pm No Time To Die showings." It could be interpreted as each theater provides both showings. But that seems unlikely. More likely they want two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. But the phrase "兩家電影院" could also mean "two theaters that provide those showtimes" meaning each theater has both showtimes. But the user didn't specify that each theater must have both. They just want two theaters that provide those showtimes. So we can interpret as find two theaters that each have those showtimes. But that might be too restrictive. Let's assume they want two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. So we need to call the function twice: once for Tenet at 5pm, once for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. The function expects movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[] and time: string[]. So we can call find_movie_showing with location "San Diego, CA", movie "Tenet", time ["17:00"]. Then call again with movie "No Time To Die", time ["19:30"]. The function returns any. We need to output the results. So we will call the function twice.
